speaker: Doctor
text:
The chest X-ray showing a "ground glass" appearance with reticular granulation, combined with severe retractions, grunting, and cyanosis, is highly suggestive of a surfactant deficiency disorder. Given your history as a newborn with respiratory distress, were you born prematurely, and if so, at what gestational age?

REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram.
